cases.case_label: LINE-1 insertion in SLCO1B3 in Taiwanese patients with Rotor syndrome
cases.mechanism_detail: Rotor syndrome requires biallelic loss of both SLCO1B1 and SLCO1B3. Panel sequencing of five Taiwanese patients found a LINE-1 insertion in SLCO1B3 on a haplotype linked with SLCO1B1 c.1738C>T p.R580*: three patients were homozygous for this haplotype and one was heterozygous for it opposite a second haplotype. The effect of the insertion on SLCO1B3 was not studied.
cases.quote: Genetic analysis using panel-based next generation sequencing revealed three patients with homozygous mutations c.1738C>T (p.R580∗) in SLCO1B1 and a transposon LINE-1 insertion in SLCO1B3
